name: AAPL 57th Annual Meeting 2026

description: The 57th annual meeting of the American Academy of Psychiatry and the Law, the main United States forensic psychiatry meeting, accredited for a maximum of 31.75 AMA PRA Category 1 credits. The Forensic Psychiatry Review Course is held in the days immediately before the meeting.
